profile.tagline: I build systems that watch what others miss.
profile.bio: Self-taught full-stack developer. I split my time between writing code and prototyping — my playground is systems programming, security tooling, and anything that turns raw background noise into something a human can actually read. OmniSight grew out of that obsession.

inventions.name: OmniSight
inventions.tagline: A black box for your operating system.
inventions.description:
OmniSight is a lightweight, asynchronous desktop framework that watches your entire user profile in real time — every file created, renamed, deleted, and every process spawned. Instead of relying on virus signatures, it streams raw behavioral telemetry into one live, inspectable feed, so unusual activity is visible the moment it happens, not after the damage is done.

—OmniSight, It never sleeps.

inventions.name: Pulse Grid
inventions.description: A visualization engine that absorbs thousands of events per second without choking the browser. Canvas rendering, client-side aggregation, history compressed in memory.

inventions.name: Atlas CLI
inventions.description: A command-line tool that scaffolds an entire project — API, database, front-end, CI — from a simple schema described in YAML.
